payout_quote: To qualify for a $400 cash bonus, you are required to do ALL of the following: 1) Open a new Huntington Perks Checking account with your promotion code by September 30, 2026. 2) Set up and receive total qualifying direct deposits of $500 or more within 90 days from account opening. Qualifying direct deposits are regular, periodic automated clearing house (ACH) credits, which may include payroll, salary, pension or government payments (such as Social Security). Deposits that DO NOT QUALIFY are those through the Real-Time Payments (RTP) network, and payments through peer-to-peer networks such as PayPal, Zelle, Venmo or others. These do not qualify as direct deposits. Transfers from another Huntington deposit account also do not qualify. 3) Maintain an open account status in the eligible checking account for 90 days.
